title: HydraFacial vs Oxygen Facial
h1: HydraFacial vs Oxygen facial: which one does your skin need?
desc: HydraFacial vs the O2Derm Oxygen Bomb Facial compared: how each works, what they treat, time, downtime and who each suits, at Skin & Laser Dubai Marina.
answer: HydraFacial cleanses, exfoliates, extracts blackheads and infuses serums, so it suits congested, dull or uneven skin. The O2Derm Oxygen Bomb Facial infuses oxygen, vitamins and antioxidants under a dome to hydrate and calm, so it suits dehydrated, tired or sensitive skin. Both have no downtime.
facts: Hydra: 30 to 80 min; Oxygen: about 45 min
Hydra from AED 199 + VAT; Oxygen AED 350 + VAT
body:
## Choosing

- Blackheads, oily or congested skin: HydraFacial
- Tight, dehydrated or sensitive skin: Oxygen facial
- After laser, to soothe: Oxygen facial
- Before an event: either
faq: Yes. Oxygen therapy can be added to other treatments as an add-on.
HydraFacial Gold suits congestion and mild acne; active acne needs a doctor's plan.
